title: Expected free energy as an information constraint on the Bethe Lagrangian
abstract: arXiv:2608.17167v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Active inference selects actions by minimising an expected free energy functional over predicted futures. However, adding an expectation over yet-unobserved outcomes means the free energy functional no longer has a Kullback-Leibler structure, which hinders message passing treatments of inference procedures. We propose an alternative formulation based on a Bethe free energy functional, fully supporting inference by message passing. The epistemic drive is maintained by imposing an information constraint, next to normalisation, marginalisation and form constraints, insisting that the mutual information between future observations, states and parameters given actions must be at least as large as the entropy of the goal prior. For a specific value of the corresponding Karush-Kuhn-Tucker multiplier, the stationary point of this constrained Bethe Lagrangian recovers the expected free energy solution. translated_title: 期望自由能作为Bethe拉格朗日量上的信息约束
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17167v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：主动推理通过最小化预测未来上的期望自由能泛函来选择行动。然而，加入对尚未观测结果的期望意味着自由能泛函不再具有Kullback-Leibler结构，这阻碍了推理过程的消息传递处理。我们提出了一种基于Bethe自由能泛函的替代公式，完全支持通过消息传递进行推理。认知驱动力通过施加信息约束来维持，除了归一化、边缘化和形式约束之外，该约束要求未来观测、状态和参数在给定行动下的互信息至少与目标先验的熵一样大。对于相应的Karush-Kuhn-Tucker乘子的特定值，这个受约束的Bethe拉格朗日量的驻点恢复了期望自由能解。我们表明，随着信息需求的增加，...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Bethe自由能泛函的替代公式，通过施加信息约束来维持认知驱动力，并支持消息传递推理，其驻点可恢复期望自由能解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an alternative formulation based on a Bethe free energy functional, maintaining the epistemic drive via an information constraint and fully supporting message passing inference, whose stationary point recovers the expected free energy solution.
